name: Dane Sweeny
intro: Dane Sweeny is a surprise star from Australia. He is 25. He is only 170 cm tall, but he plays big. He just beat a seeded star to reach the third round of a Grand Slam for the first time ever.
story: Dane grew up on the Sunshine Coast, near the beach. He started hitting balls at age two. His dad Clay is his coach. Clay sold his business so he could travel with Dane. Dane got into this US Open with a special invite called a wildcard. Then he beat Lorenzo Musetti, one of the seeded stars. He says the tennis journey is a roller coaster.

funFacts.text: He started hitting at age two with a plastic totem tennis racket.
His dad Clay is his coach. He sold his cleaning business to travel with Dane.
His tennis life began on the beach at Mooloolaba, hitting balls with his dad.
He is 170 cm tall. That is about 5 feet 7 inches.
He uses meditation and mindful breathing to stay calm on court.
He says he plays with his heart on his sleeve.
This is his very first time playing at the US Open.

watchFor: Watch him dive for volleys at the net. He flies through the air like a superhero.
